Option B — our data.
Grade + Structure/Market split, cost to exit, no-exit flags, speculative labels. Nothing here can be pulled from a public API.

Option A — the original.
Trending, prices, % change, news. Familiar and easy to read, but every number is someone else's feed.
Holdings carry the cost of leaving, quoted at the user's own size. TSLAon has no route out at all — the strongest thing we can tell a holder.
All grades, scores and exit costs are measured from live data on 16 Sep 2026 (Jupiter quotes, tokens.xyz, Pyth). Portfolio values are a sample wallet.
